citation: Han et al. (2022/2024), FOLIO: Natural Language Reasoning with First-Order Logic
key_strength: Human-authored premise sets with FOL annotations and automated verification make validity and inferential structure inspectable.
key_failure: Deductive validity dominates; implicit warrants, defeasible defeat, and cross-tradition scholastic discourse are largely absent.
evidence_basis: 12_deductive_benchmarks_summaries.md §6; benchmark_studies.csv: 1,430 conclusions over 487 premise sets with FOL annotations and verification.

citation: Tafjord, Dalvi Mishra & Clark (2021), “ProofWriter: Generating Implications, Proofs, and Abductive Statements over Natural Language.”
key_strength: Enumerated proofs, depth controls, open/closed-world settings, and abductive statements provide unusually strong stepwise dependency diagnostics.
key_failure: Theories and language are generated rather than historically situated scholarly arguments; authenticity and annotation realism are low.
evidence_basis: 07_neurosymbolic_summaries.md §1; 12_deductive_benchmarks_summaries.md §4; benchmark_studies.csv: rule-theory/proof dataset.

citation: Tafjord, Dalvi, and Clark (2021), ProofWriter
key_strength: ProofWriter exposes explicit proof traces, implications, abduction, and depth settings, allowing failures to be localized to missing premises or invalid steps.
key_failure: Duplicate benchmark family/version with S07P01; should not be counted as independent evidence without version-family annotation.
evidence_basis: 12_deductive_benchmarks_summaries.md §4; benchmark_studies.csv: True/False/Unknown, open/closed-world, proofs, abduction, depth.

citation: Ruiz-Dolz, Kikteva & Lawrence (2025), “Mining Complex Patterns of Argumentative Reasoning in Natural Language Dialogue.”
key_strength: QT-SCHEMES uses dialogue arguments annotated with 24 schemes, directly supporting scheme recovery and non-deductive structure analysis.
key_failure: Small corpus and scheme labels do not guarantee reliable implicit-premise or validity judgments; annotation agreement/artifact access require confirmation.
evidence_basis: 25_ai_philosophy_dialectical_methods_summaries.md §13; 09_argument_mining_summaries.md §19; benchmark_studies.csv: 441 annotated arguments.

citation: Yang et al. (2023), LeanDojo: Theorem Proving with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
key_strength: LeanDojo/ReProver offers fine-grained premise-use annotations and executable proof dependencies, ideal for context-selection and dependency-preservation controls.
key_failure: Lean theorem proving is a formal-library proxy, not natural-language scholarly/philosophical reasoning; no cross-tradition or defeasible semantics.
evidence_basis: 14_premise_context_selection_summaries.md §8; 08_logic_theorem_provers_summaries.md §4; benchmark_studies.csv: premise annotations and retrieval benchmark.

citation: Ruiz-Dolz, Kikteva & Lawrence (2025), “Mining Complex Patterns of Argumentative Reasoning in Natural Language Dialogue”
key_strength: The same QT-SCHEMES resource is a direct argument-scheme diagnostic with dialogue-level structure and causal/practical patterns.
key_failure: Duplicate of S09P08; aggregate selection must collapse the shared resource family for claims about coverage.
evidence_basis: 25_ai_philosophy_dialectical_methods_summaries.md §13; benchmark_studies.csv: 441 dialogue arguments, 24 schemes.

citation: Glockner et al. (2025), Grounding Fallacies Misrepresenting Scientific Publications in Evidence
key_strength: MISSCI PLUS grounds fallacy reconstruction in passages from real scientific publications, linking retrieval, claim distortion, verbalization, and fact checking.
key_failure: Fallacy reconstruction is narrower than full argument-form and dialectical skeleton recovery; annotation validity depends on source-passage alignment.
evidence_basis: 11_fallacy_detection_summaries.md §8; benchmark_studies.csv: real study passages, retrieval, verbalization, fact checking.

citation: Tian et al. (2021), Diagnosing the First-Order Logical Reasoning Ability Through LogicNLI
key_strength: LogicNLI isolates first-order logical operators and robustness with explicit logical structure, useful for controlled reasoning ablations.
key_failure: Primarily generated/formalized NLI; limited scholarly authenticity, implicit premises, and argumentation beyond deductive labels.
evidence_basis: 12_deductive_benchmarks_summaries.md §5; benchmark_studies.csv: FOL NLI for diagnosis and robustness.

citation: Mikuła et al. (2024), “Magnushammer.”
key_strength: Magnushammer provides proof-state/relevant-premise pairs and measurable premise-selection dependencies.
key_failure: Isabelle proof states are a formal-library proxy; retrieval success is not evidence of natural-language argument interpretation or scholastic reasoning.
evidence_basis: 14_premise_context_selection_summaries.md §9; 08_logic_theorem_provers_summaries.md §5; benchmark_studies.csv: premise pairs.

citation: Yang et al. (2023), “LeanDojo.”
key_strength: LeanDojo exposes formal proof states and premise annotations, supporting rigorous dependency and selection evaluation.
key_failure: Same resource family as 14-08 and S08P04; theorem-prover interaction overstates transfer to authentic prose unless paired with text benchmarks.
evidence_basis: 07_neurosymbolic_summaries.md §8; benchmark_studies.csv: 98,734 theorem/proof instances.

citation: Visser et al. (2021), “Annotating Argument Schemes.”
key_strength: US2016G1tvWALTON operationalizes Walton scheme annotation over argument material, making scheme labels and warrants inspectable.
key_failure: Scheme annotation is not equivalent to full validity, historical fidelity, or exhaustive implicit-premise reconstruction; political/general-domain coverage is narrow.
evidence_basis: 10_walton_schemes_nlp_summaries.md §7; benchmark_studies.csv: annotated Walton-scheme corpus.

citation: Peldszus & Stede (2019), “Determining Relative Argument Specificity and Stance for Complex Argumentative Structures”
key_strength: A manually curated corpus of 95,312 claims across 741 controversial topics and 2–6 level argument trees supplies real complex argumentative structure.
key_failure: Stance and specificity labels are not complete scheme, premise, provenance, or proof annotations; topic controversy may introduce annotation subjectivity.
evidence_basis: 23_disputatio_dialectical_ai_summaries.md §12; benchmark_studies.csv: manually curated complex argument trees.

citation: Goffredo et al. (2023), Argument-based Detection and Classification of Fallacies in Political Debates
key_strength: ElecDeb60To16 extension includes fallacy spans, claims, premises, support/attack relations, and six categories in political debates.
key_failure: Fallacy categories can collapse richer dialectical relations; debate domain and annotation agreement constrain generalization.
evidence_basis: 11_fallacy_detection_summaries.md; benchmark_studies.csv: spans, claims, premises, support/attack.

citation: Yang et al. (2023), “LeanDojo.”
key_strength: LeanDojo supplies executable theorem/proof data and premise annotations for direct dependency checks.
key_failure: Duplicate of S07P08/14-08 and formal rather than scholarly text; keep as a version/ perspective record, not independent corpus evidence.
evidence_basis: 08_logic_theorem_provers_summaries.md §4; benchmark_studies.csv: proof dataset/toolkit and premise annotations.

citation: Singh, Inoue, Mim, Naitoh & Inui (2021), “Annotating Implicit Reasoning in Arguments with Causal Links,” arXiv:2110.13692.
key_strength: Causal-link annotation explicitly targets implicit reasoning bridges in arguments, making hidden inferential steps more visible than ordinary relation labels.
key_failure: Small/specialized materials and causal-link framing do not establish full scheme taxonomy, proof validity, or cross-tradition coverage.
evidence_basis: 18_toulmin_defeasible_summaries.md §11; benchmark_studies.csv: implicit-reasoning causal-link materials.

citation: Reisert, Inoue, Okazaki & Inui (2017), “A Corpus of Deep Argumentative Structures as an Explanation to Argumentative Relations,” arXiv:1712.02480.
key_strength: Deep argumentative structures encode multilevel support relations over complex natural arguments, useful for reconstructing defeasible evidence aggregation.
key_failure: Structure depth is not the same as annotated warrants or valid proof; source genre and annotation protocol need closer audit.
evidence_basis: 18_toulmin_defeasible_summaries.md; 23_disputatio_dialectical_ai_summaries.md §12; benchmark_studies.csv: argumentative-structure corpus.

citation: Glockner et al. (2024), MISSCI: Reconstructing Fallacies in Misrepresented Science
key_strength: MISSCI links misinformation claims to cited biomedical publications and reconstructs implicit fallacy structure, combining authentic evidence with explicit reasoning targets.
key_failure: Biomedical misinformation is a specialized genre; implicit-fallacy reconstruction may not transfer to scholastic disputation or general argument schemes.
evidence_basis: 11_fallacy_detection_summaries.md §6; benchmark_studies.csv: cited biomedical publications and implicit fallacy reconstruction.

citation: Bezou-Vrakatseli, Cocarascu & Modgil (2024), “EthiX.”
key_strength: EthiX contains manually curated Kialo arguments across 22 ethical topics with eight Walton classes, giving authentic argumentative text and scheme labels.
key_failure: Kialo discussions are contemporary crowdsourced ethical debate, not primary scholastic/philosophical texts; eight classes provide partial taxonomy coverage.
evidence_basis: 10_walton_schemes_nlp_summaries.md §9; benchmark_studies.csv: 686 manually curated arguments.

citation: Xu et al. (2026), Socrates or Smartypants: Testing Logic Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models with Logic Programming-Based Test Oracles
key_strength: SMARTYPAT combines 502 Reddit posts with fine-grained labels and Prolog-based controlled generation/oracles, yielding deterministic structural checks.
key_failure: Synthetic oracle-generated material and fallacy classification do not prove deep natural-language inference or scholarly authenticity; source annotation quality needs independent audit.
evidence_basis: 11_fallacy_detection_summaries.md §12; benchmark_studies.csv: 502 Reddit posts and Prolog oracles.

citation: Clark, Tafjord, and Richardson (2020), Transformers as Soft Reasoners over Language
key_strength: RuleTaker gives clean depth-controlled rule deduction with theorem-prover-derived labels and reproducible interventions.
key_failure: It is explicitly synthetic and tests rule following rather than scholarly text, implicit premises, defeasible argumentation, or provenance.
evidence_basis: 12_deductive_benchmarks_summaries.md §3; benchmark_studies.csv: generated theories, facts/rules, depth labels.
